SELECT
  str,
  interval,
  date_trunc(str, ts) = date_bin(interval::interval, ts, timestamp '2001-01-01') AS equal
FROM (
  VALUES
  ('week', '7 d'),
  ('day', '1 d'),
  ('hour', '1 h'),
  ('minute', '1 m'),
  ('second', '1 s'),
  ('millisecond', '1 ms'),
  ('microsecond', '1 us')
) intervals (str, interval),
(VALUES (timestamp '2020-02-29 15:44:17.71393')) ts (ts)

sql:
SELECT d1 as "timestamp",
   extract(microseconds from d1) AS microseconds,
   extract(milliseconds from d1) AS milliseconds,
   extract(seconds from d1) AS seconds,
   round(extract(julian from d1)) AS julian,
   extract(epoch from d1) AS epoch
   FROM TIMESTAMP_TBL
shape: SELECT d1 AS "timestamp", EXTRACT(MICROSECONDS FROM d1) AS microseconds, EXTRACT(MILLISECONDS FROM d1) AS milliseconds, EXTRACT(SECONDS FROM d1) AS seconds, round(EXTRACT(JULIAN FROM d1)) AS julian, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d1) AS epoch FROM TIMESTAMP_TBL;
